name: The blade’s will is subdued

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: The seeker resists the sword’s command and brings its will to heel. Quel’Delar survives the struggle; neither its steel nor the story’s inherited name is discarded. Yet victory in the Halls of Reflection is only restraint. The blade was reforged with the dark ore of Icecrown, and a quieted weapon may still bear the touch of the place that shaped it. A voice from the chamber names the deeper danger.
